create_batch_layout_packed: create a BatchLayout for a 1D packed tensor with shape and sequence lengths
create_batch_layout_padded: create a BatchLayout for a 2D padded batch tensor with shape and sequence lengths
build_batch_layout_from_tensor: build a BatchLayout from an existing PyTorch tensor using the static of method
review_position_indices: review the BatchLayout position_indices property to get per-sequence position tensors with padding marked as -1
summarize_seq_lens: summarize the BatchLayout seq_lens and seq_lens_pt properties to inspect sequence length data
